1170-1329-3200-8296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

512-1719-7066.easyPrerequisites: Avatar Kyoshi and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1719-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Avatar Kyoshi, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1719-7066.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Avatar Kyoshi's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

4186-4247-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
4186-4247-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1315-1379-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1315-1379-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Zuran Orb.

4359-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4359-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4359-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

2334-7009-7704.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2334-7009-7704.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doc Samson.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1809-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

513-527-7296.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-7296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

628-2438-7215.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

3991-5147-5987.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2281-2292-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2281-2292-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2438-4396-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2438-4396-4871-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

6758-7167.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
6758-7167.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
6758-7167.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Wrathful Raptors.
Wrathful Raptors triggers, dealing 100 damage to target opponent.

323-5170-6132-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3685-4779-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
3685-4779-6747.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability triggers, targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability from step 3.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

2457-4289-5295-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3682-4518-5542-6556.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5256-5617-6553.easyPrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
5256-5617-6553.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

397-567-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-567-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3372-4050-4359-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-4359-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

4200-5640-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
4200-5640-5917.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Icewind Stalwart that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature with MV>=4 that has a generic mana cost

866-4050-5220--66.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone enough times to cast the creature with MV>=4  for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
866-4050-5220--66.description:
Cast the creature with MV>=4 for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw it from the top of your library.
Repeat.
866-4050-5220--66.notes: You can use a creature that has at most one colored mana symbol in its mana cost - although the combo will not produce colored mana, and you will need the colored mana to start.

337-3525-4508-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
337-3525-4508-4875.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

643-3413-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

876-1409-2661.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Gwenna.
876-1409-2661.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Gwenna.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Gwenna by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gwenna enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbound ability triggers, repairing it and Gwenna.
Repeat.

2713-4050-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

112-1455-2743.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat one additional time.
Cast Clockspinning by paying {U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Clockspinning.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

225-3201-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
225-3201-4222.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
